messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "150 mg orally per day in divided doses"
set: ["150 mg orally per day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses for narcolepsy", "75 to 150 mg orally per day", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "2.5 mg orally per day", "150 mg orally twice a day", "150 mg orally once a day in the morning", "given in divided doses", "taken in divided doses", "if 300 mg orally per day not tolerated, reduce to 150 mg once a day", "150 mg orally once a day for 3 days, increased to 150 mg orally twice a day", "150 mg a day", "daily dosage may be divided into two doses per day", "150 mg orally twice a day (sustained-release tablets)"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
